features.what: Add a ticket with name, price, capacity, sales window and what it includes.
steps: Open Tickets > Ticket Setup > 1.1 Create Tickets.
Click + Create ticket.
Enter Ticket name and Price in dollars.
Set Capacity, Opens and Closes if needed.
Tick Show on the website. A free ticket cannot be shown.
Click Create ticket.
features.statusNote: The ticket saves and shows on the website. Nobody can buy it until a Stripe key is set, because checkout refuses without one.

features.feature: Edit a ticket price or details
features.what: Change price, tagline, inclusions, capacity or sales dates on an existing ticket. The website picks it up at once.
steps: Open Tickets > Ticket Setup > 1.1 Create Tickets.
Click Edit on the ticket row.
Change the fields.
Click Save changes.
features.statusNote: Saves to the live catalogue. Past orders keep the price they paid.

features.what: Take a ticket off the public tickets page, or put it back. Tickets cannot be deleted.
steps: Open Tickets > Ticket Setup > 1.1 Create Tickets.
Click Hide or Show on the ticket row.

features.what: Reset the sold number on a ticket after refunds, using the figure counted from orders.
steps: Open Tickets > Ticket Setup > 1.1 Create Tickets.
Click Edit on the ticket row.
Under the form, click Correct the sold count.
Check Sold, which is prefilled from orders, and enter Why.
Click Correct the count.

features.what: List invoiced and multi-seat orders with seats, totals and payment status.
steps: Open Tickets > Ticket Setup > Create Group Tickets.
Read the Group orders table.
features.statusNote: Group orders are placed on the website. There is no group ticket or group discount to set up here, and no order can be placed until a Stripe key exists.

features.what: Build the questions buyers answer at checkout, limit a question to certain tickets, reorder, remove, and switch the form on or off.
steps: Open Tickets > Ticket Setup > 1.2 Question Forms.
Under Add a question, enter the Question and pick an Answer type.
Tick Required if needed. Pick tickets under Ask only on, or leave empty for everyone.
Click Add question.
Use Edit, Move up or Remove on a row. After Edit, click Save question.
Click Start asking to turn the form on.
features.statusNote: Questions save and show at checkout. No answers can come in until a Stripe key is set, because checkout refuses without one. Start asking is disabled until one question exists.

features.what: See which purchase, invoice and refund emails were sent, failed or skipped, with the provider error.
steps: Open Tickets > Ticket Setup > 1.3 Confirmation Emails.
Read Recent sends.
features.statusNote: Templates cannot be edited and there is no resend button. Sends fail for every address but the owner until the Resend domain is verified.

features.what: Shows which tickets include workshops and the video library.
steps: Open Tickets > Ticket Setup > Ticket Add-ons.
features.statusNote: Add-ons cannot be created or sold. The two inclusions are edited as checkboxes on 1.1 Create Tickets.

features.what: Create percent or fixed discount codes with a redemption limit and expiry, and turn codes off.
steps: Open Tickets > Ticket Setup > Discount Codes.
Enter a code, the type and the amount.
Set a limit and expiry if needed.
Click Create code.
features.statusNote: No STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is set, so the form is not shown and the action refuses.

features.what: Lists hidden tickets that can be sold by private link.
steps: Open Tickets > Ticket Setup > 1.1 Create Tickets and click Hide on the ticket.
Open Tickets > Ticket Setup > Member & Invite-Only Ticketing to see hidden tickets.
features.statusNote: No membership check exists. The only options are a hidden ticket or a discount code, and codes are blocked.

features.feature: Membership system guides (MemberClicks, iMIS, YourMembership, Neon CRM)
features.what: Explains how to move data to a membership system by CSV export.
steps: Open Tickets > Ticket Setup and pick the guide.
Follow the link to Analytics & Exports and download the CSV.
Import the CSV in the other system.
features.statusNote: Text guides only. No connection exists for any of the four systems.

features.what: Describes which parts of session booking exist.
steps: Open Tickets > Ticket Setup > Session RSVP.
features.statusNote: Attendees cannot book a seat in a session and nothing counts or closes a session. Only session capacity and workshop eligibility exist.

features.what: See every ticket the public page lists, with price, order and sold state.
steps: Open Tickets > Ticket Setup > 1.4 Registration Pages.
To change order or listing, click Create Tickets and edit the ticket.
features.statusNote: The registration page itself cannot be designed here. Order and visibility are edited on 1.1.

features.what: Gives the ticket page link to share and points to tracked links.
steps: Open Tickets > Ticket Setup > 1.5 Registration Widgets.
Copy the link.
For a credited link, open Tickets > Ticket Marketing > Campaign Link Tracking and create a code.
features.statusNote: There is no embeddable widget, only a link.

features.what: List expired and failed checkouts and unpaid invoices.
steps: Open Tickets > Ticket Setup > 1.6 Abandoned Registration.
features.statusNote: No reminder email can be sent from here.

features.what: See open date, close date and capacity for every ticket in one table.
steps: Open Tickets > Ticket Setup > 1.7 Registration Settings.
To change a value, open 1.1 Create Tickets and edit the ticket.
features.statusNote: No form here. No event-wide settings such as order limits or a refund policy exist.

features.what: List exhibitor packages and edit their price, capacity and inclusions.
steps: Open Tickets > Exhibitor Ticket Setup > 2.1 Exhibitor Tickets.
Click Edit on a package. The ticket form on 1.1 opens.
Change the fields and click Save changes.
To add one, open 1.1 Create Tickets, click + Create ticket, set Catalogue to Exhibitors and click Create ticket.
features.statusNote: Packages save and list on /tickets/exhibitor. Nobody can buy one online until a Stripe key is set. Use 2.6 Offline Payment meanwhile.

features.what: Build the questions exhibitors answer at checkout.
steps: Open Tickets > Exhibitor Ticket Setup > 2.2 Question Forms.
Under Add a question, enter the Question and pick an Answer type.
Click Add question.
Click Start asking.
features.statusNote: The live form has no questions yet. Questions save, but no answers can come in until a Stripe key is set. Offline payments skip the questions.

features.what: Add booths to the floor, assign or hold a booth for an exhibitor, release it, or block a space.
steps: Open Tickets > Exhibitor Ticket Setup > 2.3 Booth Selection.
Under Allocate a space, pick the Booth and the Exhibitor.
Tick Hold only if the booth is promised but unpaid.
Click Allocate.
Use Release, Block or Unblock on a row.
Under Add a space, enter Number, size and zone, then click Add booth.
features.statusNote: The organizer assigns booths by hand. Exhibitors cannot pick a booth during checkout.

features.what: See receipts sent to exhibitor buyers and any failures.
steps: Open Tickets > Exhibitor Ticket Setup > 2.4 Confirmation Emails.
features.statusNote: Read-only log. No template editing or resend.

features.what: Compare staff passes claimed against the allocation per exhibitor, and list low-priced extras.
steps: Open Tickets > Exhibitor Ticket Setup > 2.5 Ticket Add-ons.
Read the staff pass table for over-claims.
To fix an allocation, click the exhibitor name to open Exhibitor Manager.
features.statusNote: No add-on product exists. An extra is sold as another exhibitor ticket made on 1.1.

features.what: Points to the shared discount code screen.
steps: Open Tickets > Exhibitor Ticket Setup > Discount Codes.
Click Discount Codes (all audiences).
features.statusNote: Codes need a Stripe key, and a code cannot be limited to exhibitors.

features.what: Issue a ticket for a wire, cheque or contract payment. It creates the registration, the order and the sold count.
steps: Open Tickets > Exhibitor Ticket Setup > 2.6 Offline Payment.
Pick the Package.
Enter Name, Email, Amount received and Why.
Tick Do not send a confirmation only if the buyer needs no email.
Click Record payment.
Copy the claim code shown and give it to the buyer.
features.statusNote: The order and registration are written. The confirmation email fails for any address but the owner until the Resend domain is verified.

features.what: See which exhibitors have no order on record, and record a pre-paid or free package for them.
steps: Open Tickets > Exhibitor Ticket Setup > Pre-Paid Exhibitors.
Check the Reconciliation table for "no order".
Under Record a pre-paid or comped package, pick the Package.
Enter Name, Email, Amount received (0 for a comp) and Why.
Click Record payment.
features.statusNote: Recording works. The confirmation email fails for any address but the owner until the Resend domain is verified.

features.what: See open date, close date and capacity for each exhibitor package.
steps: Open Tickets > Exhibitor Ticket Setup > Registration Settings.
To change a value, open 2.1 Exhibitor Tickets and click Edit.
features.statusNote: No form here.

features.what: See the packages listed on the public exhibitor page and open the live page.
steps: Open Tickets > Exhibitor Ticket Setup > 2.7 Registration Page.
Click View the live page.
features.statusNote: The page cannot be designed here.

features.what: Gives the exhibitor registration link to share.
steps: Open Tickets > Exhibitor Ticket Setup > 2.8 Registration Widget.
Copy the link.
features.statusNote: No embeddable widget, only a link.

uiIssues.issue: The 200px side menu stays beside the content on a phone, so every page body is squeezed into about 160px and tables show one column at a time. Long page titles ("Confirmation", "MemberClicks", "YourMembership") and the tag and links beside them are cut off at the right edge.
uiIssues.fix: Add a max-width 700px rule that stacks the rail above the content, or collapses it behind a Menu button, and lets the content take full width. Let page titles break words.
uiIssues.source: apps/organizer/src/app/globals.css (.sidebar, only one phone media query in the file)

uiIssues.issue: The event header breaks on a phone: the date and venue wrap one word per line under the title and the Registrations and Agenda cards run off the right edge (div.cards ends at 488px).
uiIssues.fix: Stack the event meta and the stat cards in a column under 700px.

uiIssues.issue: Form inputs, selects and help text are wider than the panel and are cut off at the right edge, so typed text and the booth help text cannot be read.
uiIssues.fix: Give form controls max-width: 100% and box-sizing: border-box, and let help text wrap.

uiIssues.issue: Table rows grow 200 to 470px tall because long-text columns wrap off screen. The confirmation email page is about 6,500px of mostly blank rows. Caused by the side menu squeeze.
uiIssues.fix: On phones render each row as a stacked card, or cap the long column with a line clamp.

uiIssues.issue: The empty Extras table shows a full sentence in 20px bold grey inside a 400px tall box. The Netlify badge covers part of it. On a phone the text overlaps the table header.
uiIssues.fix: Pass a short string such as "No extras yet" as the empty prop and move the instruction to a normal paragraph under the table.

uiIssues.issue: The page says "No discount codes has been entered" with no form and no reason. The cause, a missing Stripe key, shows only in a small grey tag.
uiIssues.fix: Replace the empty state with one line: "Discount codes need a Stripe key."

uiIssues.issue: Empty states read "No group orders has been entered", "No questions has been entered". The verb is wrong for plurals.
uiIssues.fix: Change the NotInputted copy to "No {what} yet."

uiIssues.issue: Engineering notes are shown to the organizer: "apps/web, port 3200", "Seats come from items on the order document", "The timestamp comes from refundedAt", "quantitySold >= quantityTotal ... npm run reconcile:sold", "orders reference a ticket type by id", "The two collections have no link".
uiIssues.fix: Delete these notes or cut each to one plain line, for example "Tickets cannot be deleted. Hide them instead."

uiIssues.issue: Long opinion copy sits above and inside simple forms: "A hundred distinct sentences is a list, not a distribution", "They have done nothing wrong", "this is the record of what your word was based on", "worth reading this table in April rather than in May", "The one recoverable case".
uiIssues.fix: Keep one short hint per field at most, for example "Required. Saved on the order." and drop the rest.

uiIssues.issue: These screens are essays about what is missing: "There are exactly two, and they are booleans on the ticket type", "The three ways to restrict a ticket, ranked by what we have", "Missing. There is no per-session registration document", field names like SessionDoc.capacity.
uiIssues.fix: Reduce each to a two-line statement of what the organizer can do and a link to the screen where they do it, or hide the nav item.

uiIssues.issue: Email subjects use an em dash between "Your KGC 2027 ticket" and the ticket name, and a seeded question hint has one after "Not a booking". The banner promises "the send is re-run" but there is no re-run control. Raw provider JSON is printed in each failed row.
uiIssues.fix: Use a colon in the subject and hint, drop the re-run promise or add the button, and show only the provider message text.

uiIssues.issue: Row actions (Edit, Hide, Release, Block, Move up, Remove) are 12px text links with no padding, stacked a few pixels apart, and sit in the last table column which is off screen on a phone.
uiIssues.fix: Give row actions at least 32px height and spacing, and keep them visible in a stacked phone row.

uiIssues.issue: A "Powered by Netlify" badge floats over the right side of the content and covers table text.
uiIssues.fix: Turn off the Netlify badge in the site settings.
